measurements.beat_grid: downbeats 10-20 ms ahead of the 0.5s video grid (under 1 frame)

verified_fixes: 10.0-11.0s: the dead page is gone. The 04 / ANGLE frame stays above the rising off-white page and travels and shrinks to the signature frame. The front view slides in over the three-quarter view at about 10.7-10.77s, and the signature page continues with no re-reveal. The product is on screen in every frame.
8.0-8.4s and 9.0-9.4s: the label and cap sit inside single bands. No frame edge or background is exposed, and the bands re-register cleanly.
3.73-3.97s: NOIR fades out while the window settles.
0.3s: the slit starts opening and the cap shows by about f10.

issues.issue: For about 5 frames the big O still sits at full opacity over the bottle's 'NOIR' label before the fade starts.
issues.fix: Optional: start the word fade about 4 frames earlier (around f107), or nudge the window crop so the label clears the O.

issues.issue: SCENT. is cut off by the rising page edge instead of leaving on its own. This is acceptable, but slightly abrupt.
issues.fix: Optional: fade SCENT. over 4-6 frames starting about f308, so it has cleared before the page edge reaches it.

issues.issue: Faint 1px seam lines between the bands stay visible during the shift.
issues.fix: Optional: let the seams fade to 0 as the bands re-register, so they read as intentional rules.

issues.issue: The tiles are upscaled from about 341px sources. At the current 640-660px size the softness is acceptable, but the cap edges and label type are slightly soft at 1:1.
issues.fix: Optional: a light unsharp mask and 1-2% grain on the tiles. Do not enlarge them further.

strengths: There is one continuous editorial layout system with no resets: hairline, slit, wordmark, window, lead frame, drop frame, travelling frame, then signature.
The music lock is exact: the bass drop lands at 8.01s and every cut is within about 15ms of an onset.
The palette and typography are disciplined (black and off-white, silver accents, Cormorant and Montserrat), with no cheap effects, and the end-card accent is earned.
